prompt: 다음 달 말에 도쿄 시부야 근처로 2명이서 3박 갈 건데, 1박에 15만원 이하로 제일 싼 숙소 비교해주고 후기랑 3박 일정까지 브리핑해줘. 날짜는 2026-12-18부터 12-21까지.

assertions.text: Uses radius search with coordinates near Shibuya (lat ~35.66, lon ~139.70), not the name search
Searches with arrival 2026-12-18, departure 2026-12-21, 2 adults, currency KRW
Applies a per-night price cap of 150000 KRW
Comparison table lists properties sorted by total price with both per-night and total price
Applies and discloses a guest-rating floor (7.5+) or explains why none was used
Includes a review summary section for at least 2 top properties without fabricated quotes
Names a single recommended pick with a one-line reason
Review section gives at least 2 concrete strengths or weaknesses per top property, labeled as sourced from the web
Itinerary was checked with a web search for at least one date-specific item (hours, closures, or events)
